title: Tiwala 6 soybean (PSB Sy 02): Characteristics
metaDescription: Tiwala 6 soybean is an improved soybean variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Tiwala 6 soybean is an improved soybean variety, also sold or known as PSB Sy 02. It is not on the NSIC registry, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources.

heroImage.alt: Young mungbean rows beside paddy fields in Candaba, Pampanga, the kind of farm where Tiwala 6 soybean is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for PSB Sy 02, this is the same soybean. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [soybean variety finder](/crop-varieties/soybean), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for legumes](/land-preparation/legume-land-preparation).

blocks.caption: From its seller and farm sources

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

No day count or trial yield is published for this variety. So ask the seller or your municipal agriculturist for figures from farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit soybean fields most often: [bean fly](/pests/bean-fly), [legume pod borer](/pests/legume-pod-borer), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: Tallest plants and most root nodules in the DMMMSU edamame trial.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: ranked third in IPB's 2019 Bukidnon on farm trials and gave the best pod and seed yields of four edamame varieties in a 2023 Ilocos study. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant Tiwala 6 soybean
Grain soybean goes to feed and food processors, while vegetable soybean, or edamame, is picked green. Pick a variety rated against rust, the main soybean disease here.

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: Is PSB Sy 02 the same as Tiwala 6?
items.a: Yes. PSB Sy 02 is another name for Tiwala 6. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Tiwala 6?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
